text:
Ana Morales: Quick scheduling heads-up — candidate Priyanka Sharma has childcare in the evenings and can only interview between 6:15pm–8:00pm PT next Tue (5/12) or Wed (5/13). Hiring manager @Kevin Wu prefers Wed if possible. Can the panel rotate to a single condensed slot (45–60min) around 6:30–7:15pm PT? We also need to confirm childcare reimbursement (she asked) and a quiet room if she comes onsite.

Kevin Wu: Wed 6:30pm PT works for me. I can take the first 30–40m. Thanks for flagging — I can be flexible by 15m if needed.

Gabe Singh: I can do Wed but 6:30pm PT is tight — I can be online by 6:45pm PT. If we keep it to 45m that's fine. Prefer remote.

Lina Torres: I have back-to-backs Wed evening but can move one meeting to make 6:30pm PT work. OK to run a condensed loop.

Ana Morales: Great — looks like Wed is preferred. Plan: 6:30–7:15pm PT condensed panel; Kevin leads first 30m, then technical follow-ups with Gabe/Lina. Candidate will be remote unless she indicates otherwise.

Onboarding Bot: Policy note — caregiver/childcare reimbursement available: up to $100 per candidate for interview-related childcare when pre-approved. Submit receipts to Expensify with expense code "CARE-INTERVIEW" and tag "people-ops". Internal policy: approval must be logged before payment.

Ana Morales: I'll pre-approve the stipend for Priyanka. Ana -> @Kevin to confirm final panel list and @Gabe/@Lina for exact start time (we'll aim 6:30pm PT but Gabe looks like 6:45pm ok). Also reserving a quiet room in-office (Room A3) as backup in case she decides to come onsite last minute.

Kevin Wu: Confirmed panel: Kevin Wu, Gabe Singh, Lina Torres. If Gabe is 6:45 we do Kevin 6:30–6:55, Gabe 6:55–7:10, Lina quick wrap 7:10–7:15. Works.

Gabe Singh: Works for me. Can you send the final Zoom link and a 2-min prep note for the candidate? Also can we include a backup Google Meet link in case Zoom hits weird latency?

Ana Morales: Sending invite now. Prep note will include interview scope, rubric, and timings. Zoom + backup Meet included. Code block below is the meeting info I'll paste in calendar: ```
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999888777
Passcode: Redwood2026
Backup Meet: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
Start: Wed 2026-05-13 18:30 PT (UTC-7)
Agenda: 6:30–6:55 Tech + system design (Kevin), 6:55–7:10 Deep dive (Gabe), 7:10–7:15 Wrap + logistics (Lina)
```

Ana Morales: Also adding the stipend pre-approval note to the candidate record and Slack DMing Priyanka with options. I'll cc People Ops receipts inbox and the recruiter. :thumbsup: 

Priyanka (candidate): Confirmed Wed 6:30pm PT and appreciates the childcare stipend option.

Ana Morales: Final check — Gabe, Lina, Kevin: any need for a test machine or special access? If candidate comes onsite she'll need a guest badge + quiet room; if remote we'll ensure a Google Doc for collaborative whiteboarding.

Gabe Singh: No test machine needed from me. Google Doc whiteboard is fine.

Lina Torres: No special access. Thanks for arranging the stipend — super helpful.

Ana Morales: Perfect — calendar invite sent (with both links and stipend note). I'll follow up with expense instructions post-interview. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
